methodology.target: open[t+2] / open[t+1] - 1; signal observed after completed close[t]
methodology.purge: training label end j+2 strictly before prediction row t; j <= t-3
methodology.validation: chronological expanding training; no random cross-validation or tuning

features.vol20: sample standard deviation of last 20 close-to-close simple returns

methodology.scaling: training-only mean and population standard deviation; constant scale=1
methodology.ridge: sum squared errors + fixed ridge_alpha * sum(beta^2); unpenalized intercept
methodology.fees: per-side wealth-proportional fees on position changes and final liquidation
methodology.benchmark: buy-and-hold over identical entry/exit dates with identical per-side fees
methodology.adjusted_close_policy: validated if present but ignored; supplied OHLC is the sole price basis
methodology.annualization: 252 observations/year assumed, riskfree=0; sample standard deviation
methodology.max_drawdown: maximum fractional peak-to-trough loss at OOS period ends, including initial wealth=1
methodology.trade_count: one-sided position changes including final liquidation; binary long/cash
methodology.turnover: sum absolute position changes including final liquidation, not annualized
methodology.total_cost: sum actual fee debits in units of initial wealth=1, not currency
methodology.total_cost_rate: sum per-side fee fractions (fee * turnover), not compounded wealth loss
methodology.r2_oos_vs_training_mean: 1 - model squared errors / squared errors of each fold training-mean forecasts
methodology.undefined_metrics: R2 is null for zero baseline error; Sharpe null for fewer than two samples or zero volatility

data_requirements: Completed daily OHLCV bars for one asset, venue, currency and consistent price units.
Unique increasing YYYY-MM-DD dates; no sorting, interpolation or silent truncation.
Caller must attest all OHLC are consistently split-normalized or all are raw.
Corporate-action provenance and a complete session calendar must be checked upstream.
limitations: Experimental, unvalidated research baseline; no predictive edge or future returns established.
Not a replication of NBER Working Paper 25398 and not an HFT/latency model.
Hypothetical next-open fills, fractional full-wealth positions; no liquidity, impact or spread model beyond the supplied fee assumption.
Raw prices may contain split jumps; cash earns zero; dividends, taxes and financing are excluded.
The 2*fee signal threshold is a roundtrip approximation, not an exact compounded breakeven.
Repeated inspection or parameter selection on this report introduces selection bias.
source: Yahoo Finance unofficial chart endpoint; historical research only
